about: Before asset planning, the reference's recurring unit must be reviewed: single vs bunch/hand, fingers per crown, shared crown.
rules: A scene reference with repeated fruit clusters must be labeled bunch/hand with fingersMin/Max and sharedCrown.
A single-banana asset is not allowed for a bunch scene; a bunch group must share one crown/stem.
The buildPlan must carry the scene-unit review and its source file.
Mismatch fails the plan; review is independent Codex visual review, not the session's guess.
